Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Runs a program from a backend or background worker and waits for it, as pglogical runs <code>pg_dump</code> and
<code>pg_restore</code> to copy a schema.

```csharp
public static class PgChildProcess
```

<p>
.NET's <code>System.Diagnostics.Process</code> installs its own <code>SIGCHLD</code> handling, which is not safe inside a
PostgreSQL process. This starts the program with <code>posix_spawn</code> on Unix and <code>CreateProcessW</code> on Windows,
and waits on the backend's latch, so query cancellation, statement timeouts and termination still work: they stop
the program before PostgreSQL raises the interrupt.
</p>
<p>
The program inherits the server's environment, working directory and standard streams, so its output goes to the
server log; pass options such as <code>--file</code> to write results to a file. Arguments are passed exactly, including
spaces, quotes and non-ASCII text. On Windows, a program with a narrow <code>main</code>, which includes PostgreSQL's own
programs, receives them converted to the system's ANSI code page, so non-ASCII text arrives only when that code page
contains it.
</p>

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### Run(string, params ReadOnlySpan&lt;string&gt;)

Runs a program and waits for it to exit.

```csharp
public static int Run(string path, params ReadOnlySpan<string> arguments)
```

Parameters:

`path` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The program's full path, such as <code>pg_dump</code> in the server's bin directory.

`arguments` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;string&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

The arguments, after the program name.

Returns: [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The exit code, or on Unix 128 plus the signal number when a signal ended the program.

Exceptions:

- [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/): The program could not be started, or the wait was interrupted.
